name: Azuregos
summary: Along Azshara’s coast, Azuregos keeps watch over Highborne relics. Malygos entrusted their great magic to him, though he would rather study in peace and drive off anyone who breaks his watch.

sections.title: The Guardian of Eldarath
sections.body:
Azuregos roams the shores and crags around Eldarath, the ancient ruins he has made his sanctuary. Relics from before the Great Sundering still lie along these shattered coasts. As Malygos’s servant, he keeps their powerful artifacts from careless mortals.

Azuregos does not hide in a dark cave. He patrols the region openly and calls himself its lord of all magic. His humor is often sardonic, yet he fiercely defends Azshara’s treasures from adventurers seeking fame or plunder.

sections.title: A Reluctant Custodian
sections.body:
After the War of the Shifting Sands, Azuregos received the Blue Scepter Shard, one fragment of the key needed to break the barrier at the Scarab Wall. Treasure-seekers and would-be heroes came after it, bringing him constant headaches.

At last, the clever drake rid himself of the shard without ceremony. He fed it to Maws, an empowered minnow. Anyone seeking the shard must now dredge the depths instead of pestering Azuregos.

aliases: who is the blue dragon in azshara
faq.answer: Azuregos patrols Azshara’s ruins at Malygos’s command. Eccentric and witty, the blue dragon crushes mortals who interrupt his magical studies or covet Eldarath’s treasures.

aliases: what is azuregos doing in azshara
faq.answer: Azuregos studies and guards the powerful arcane artifacts the ancient Highborne left behind after the Great Sundering. He protects Eldarath’s ruins from reckless plunderers seeking dangerous magic.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Scarab Wall?
faq.answer: Azuregos received the Blue Scepter Shard, part of the key that can reopen the Scarab Wall. To learn what became of the shard, speak with the dragon.

faq.q: Why does his spirit appear in Azshara?
faq.answer: The Spirit of Azuregos appears in Azshara near the living dragon and speaks with travelers. No one explains how the spirit and dragon exist side by side.

angles.text: As a Mage, you can see Azuregos as an agent of the blue dragonflight, devoted to mastering and regulating the arcane. He regards mortal spellcasters as reckless children meddling with forces beyond their understanding.
As a Night Elf, you can find Azuregos among Eldarath’s shattered ruins, watching over Highborne sorceries that nearly tore Kalimdor apart during the Sundering.
